The trace simulates the parent's behaviour against controlled probes (one_D_TFT, four_D_TFT, four_D_ALLC, sustained_D, periodic_D) after ten externally supplied CC rounds. It proposes changes: defect on first defection, forgive on streak 1, defect on streaks 2-3, cooperate on streak 4, defect on streak >=5, and test exploit after a D streak ends.
